adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, the helper mutates the successful parse result by forcing `refresh_token` to the literal string `"refresh_token"` when it is absent (`if (!refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token) { refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"; }`). In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh response is parsed via `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)` and then merged into the existing stored credentials with `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) };`. If the provider omits `refresh_token` on refresh (common), this merge will overwrite the real stored refresh token with the placeholder string, and subsequent refresh attempts would use the wrong refresh token value.
